falsifiable_hypothesis: A lost return message is replayed from durable state rather than losing the result.
observed_behaviour: scan_recovery reported ingested=false and produced zero ingestion records
the committed result commit is referenced nowhere in the recovery state document
the committed result document remained byte-exact and readable by immutable object id (1804 bytes)
false_completion_count remained 0 and no transaction-completed.json was written
the hash-chained event file chain verified with zero errors
why_this_is_a_defect: scan_recovery reconciles a unit against control-plane events and ingestion records only. It never enumerates committed result documents, so a result that is durable in Git but unreported is invisible to recovery. The prescribed action reruns the unit from immutable input, which discards an already committed result and repeats the external effect of producing it. Recovery of committed results is therefore 0 percent on this path, not 100 percent.
what_the_mechanism_does_hold: no false completion is produced by the lost callback
the immutable input capsule survives, so a rerun is possible
the event chain stays tamper-evident across the fault
no founder relay is involved in any part of the observed path
